cases.name: nested
cases.source:
---
title: Each team picks from the same tools
---
flowchart TB
  subgraph all [Tools on offer]
    direction TB
    subgraph design [A design team]
      direction LR
      a1([Figma]) ~~~ a2([Linear]) ~~~ a3([Slack]) ~~~ a4([Notion])
    end
    subgraph data [A data team]
      direction LR
      b1([dbt]) ~~~ b2([Linear]) ~~~ b3([Slack]) ~~~ b4([Hex]) ~~~ b5([Snowflake])
    end
    design ~~~ data
  end
  all ~~~ note["Every seat is tagged with one team's tools, or with none"]

scene.label: Each team picks from the same tools

runs.s: Each team picks from the same tools
Every seat is tagged with one team's

cases.name: chain
cases.source:
--- title: A lead warms up in five steps --- flowchart LR cold(["cold"]) -.-> s1["Stranger
Has the problem, has not looked for a fix
“why is this so slow”"] s1 --> s2["Looker
Knows fixes exist, compares kinds
“what does a queue do”"] s2 --> s3["Shortlister
Weighs named products against each other
“is this one any good”"] s3 --> s4["Buyer
Knows the product and wants terms
“how long is the trial”"] s4 -.-> won(["won"])
